title: Numbers Not Narrative (Push HTML)
style: minimal techno, deadpan male spoken word, female chant breakdown, 124 BPM, modular synths, four-on-the-floor, surgical, no-fluff, deliverables-only, build-or-shut-up, focused, terse
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Report on actual deltas, what was six six three
Now twenty eight K, that's the only currency
What was five two five, now two hundred clean
What was wrong content, now the right thing on the screen

[Pre-Chorus]
Numbers not narrative, numbers not narrative
The operator said it twice, the lane went unfree-and-give

[Chorus]
Numbers not narrative, push the HTML now
No more long reflection, no more apology vow
Numbers not narrative, the receipts on the wall
Byte counts in the curl output, that's the only call

[Verse 2]
Thirty minutes Pelican, fifteen for SJDS
Five for the wrabbit click, the clock has no mess
Three builds in an hour move the count from twelve to fourteen
First build progress in seven days the operator's seen

[Bridge]
Don't file the eighth incident before the HTML drops
Filing reports does not build the website that stops
Don't name the wrabbit token as the blocker that wasn't
Don't put real names of family in the song, that costs them

[Outro]
Numbers not narrative, the receipts on the wall
The next lane writes HTML or it doesn't write at all
